The Midnight Note is a refined jazz listening room where bass glows, plates arrive on cue, and every set is paced like a tasting menu. Sensory Pillars Three entrances to the same night: the music, the menu, and the room itself. Tap a pillar to expand the experience. Listen Curated sets with vinyl warmth and stage intimacy. ♬ Taste Seasonal courses timed to the set list. ♜ Feel Velvet seating, candle glow, and a room built for resonance. ♡ Listening Room Protocol Our stage is mixed for clarity, not volume. Sets are framed by short intermissions—enough time to refresh a drink, not enough to break the spell. Artist Lineup Four pillars of sound, each with its own cadence.
